title: Marcos pays tribute to Filipino seafarers killed, injured in global conflicts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday honored Filipino seafarers who have become casualties while working in areas affected by armed conflicts and geopolitical tensions in different parts of the world. Speaking at this year’s Philippine Maritime Convention in Manila, Marcos also reaffirmed the government’s commitment to protect the rights, welfare, and safety of Filipino seafarers. “Our seafarers have found themselves caught in armed conflicts, geopolitical tensions, attacks, and other security incidents they did not create and in which they had no part,” Marcos said. “Some have suffered injuries, while others have tragically lost their lives in the line […]...
